
A task's activity records are attributed through the sessions registered against its leases. The hooks and `lode work next`/`lode task claim` register a session. A record belongs to a task when its `session.id` (log attribute, else resource attribute) matches a session registered against one of the task's leases and its `Timestamp` falls between that lease's claim and its release, or now for a held lease. Subagents share their parent's session id and are attributed with it. `service.name` gives the agent (mapped to the `agent` values of WL-REQ-288, default `claude-code`). The actor is the lease's actor.
